_note: Family-specific text and settings for the whole presentation. Edit freely; every scene reads from here.

welcome._note: The default screen, shown on the projector while guests arrive. 'photos' are ids from data/photo_inventory.json.
welcome.headline: Celebrating the Beautiful Journey of Buvaneswari
welcome.supporting: 50 Years of Love, Strength & Beautiful Memories

reveal._note: The birthday reveal, shown when the host presses Next. 'photo' is Amma's portrait (an id from data/photo_inventory.json).
reveal.message: Fifty years of you. A lifetime of us, loving you back.
reveal.photoAlt: Amma, M. Buvaneswari, smiling in a blue silk saree

videos._note: Family-supplied videos. Put the MP4 (H.264 + AAC) at the 'src' path and it appears automatically; until then the scene shows a graceful placeholder. 'poster' (an image) is optional.

lifeJourney.title: Her Life Journey
lifeJourney.missingText: Her Life Journey film is on its way.

memories.title: Our Memories, Together
memories.description: A film of her photographs, made by the family.

finale.headline: Happy 50th Birthday, Amma!
finale.subline: 50 Years of Beautiful Memories. A Lifetime of Love. Countless Reasons to Celebrate You.
finale.message: We may never be able to give back everything you have given us, but we will spend our lives making sure you always feel how deeply you are loved.

music._note: Background music. Never starts by itself: the host presses the music button (or M). It fades out while a video plays and returns afterwards. To change the track, put an MP3 in assets/audio/ and set 'src' (and 'credit').
music.title: Canon in D Major
